name: Bastion of Corruption
summary: Enemy units set up as Reinforcements cannot be placed within 12" of this model.

name: Bastion of Firepower
summary: Each time this model Remains Stationary, its ranged weapons gain Lethal Hits until the end of the turn.

name: Bloodlust
summary: Each time this model makes a Charge move, its melee weapons gain the Devastating Wounds ability until the end of the turn.

name: Brigand
summary: Ranged attacks by this model against a unit within range of an objective marker gain the Ignores Cover ability.

name: Close-range Killers (Aura)
summary: While a friendly War Dog model is within 9" of this model, that War Dog's attacks against the closest enemy unit gain +1 Armour Penetration.

name: Consumed with Hunger (Aura)
summary: While a friendly War Dog model is within 6" of this model, that War Dog can re-roll Hit rolls when attacking a Titanic or Towering unit.

name: Conversion
summary: When this weapon attacks a target beyond a set range from the bearer, an unmodified Hit roll of 4+ scores a Critical Hit instead of the normal threshold.

name: Dark Fervour (Aura)
summary: While a friendly War Dog model is within 6" of this model, that War Dog's ranged weapons gain the Assault ability.

name: Dread Dominion (Aura)
summary: While a friendly War Dog model is within 9" of this model, improve that War Dog's Leadership and Objective Control characteristics by 1 each.

name: Frenzied Rampage (Aura)
summary: While a friendly War Dog model is within 9" of this model, that War Dog re-rolls Hit rolls of 1 for its melee attacks.

name: Grav-pinned
summary: After this model shoots, an enemy Infantry unit hit by its graviton crusher has -2 Move and -2 to Charge rolls until the end of the opponent's next turn.

name: Huntmaster (Aura)
summary: While a friendly War Dog model is within 6" of this model, that War Dog's ranged weapons gain the Assault ability.

name: Huntsman
summary: This model re-rolls Wound rolls when attacking a Monster or Vehicle unit.

name: Infernal Aegis (Aura)
summary: While a friendly War Dog model is within 6" of this model, that War Dog has the Benefit of Cover.

name: Karnivore
summary: This model can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for it.

name: Macro-extinction Protocols
summary: This model adds 1 to Hit rolls against Monster or Vehicle units, and also adds 1 to the Wound roll if that target is Titanic or Towering.

name: Methodical Destruction
summary: At the start of the first battle round, choose one enemy unit as this model's victim; attacks against that unit re-roll the Wound roll. Choose a new victim whenever the current one is destroyed.

name: Obsessive Ruthlessness
summary: This unit's ranged attacks against MONSTER/VEHICLE units can ignore modifiers to this unit's BS and to Hit and Wound rolls.

name: Offerings for the Dark Gods (Aura)
summary: While a friendly War Dog model is within 6" of this model, that War Dog's ranged weapons gain Sustained Hits 1.

name: Preysight (Aura)
summary: While a friendly War Dog model is within 6" of this model, that War Dog's ranged weapons gain the Ignores Cover ability.

name: Protection Protocols
summary: You can target this unit with Heroic Intervention for -1 CP, regardless of other uses of that stratagem this phase; it does not prevent other units from also using it.

name: Repair Auto-simulacra
summary: At the end of your Command phase, this model regains up to D3 lost wounds.

name: Searing Flames
summary: After this model shoots, pick one enemy unit hit by its Acheron flame cannon; until the end of the phase that unit has no Benefit of Cover.

name: Seething Hatred
summary: Each time this model shoots or fights, re-roll one Hit roll or one Wound roll among those attacks.

name: Shock Charge
summary: You can target this model with the Crushing Impact Stratagem for 0CP, even if you already used that Stratagem on a different unit this phase.

name: Stalker
summary: This model adds 1 to the Wound roll when attacking a target that has no other enemy units within 6" of it.

name: Storm of Bolts
summary: After this model shoots, pick one hit enemy unit (Monsters/Vehicles excluded); while this model remains on the battlefield, that unit's attacks suffer -1 to Hit until your next turn.

name: Sunderer of Fortresses
summary: Each time this model attacks a VEHICLE, improve that attack's Strength and Damage by 1 (by 2 instead if the target is a FORTIFICATION).

name: Taskmaster (Aura)
summary: While a friendly War Dog model is within 9" of this model, that War Dog re-rolls Hit rolls of 1 for its ranged attacks.

name: Unrestrained Terror (Aura)
summary: Each enemy unit within Engagement Range of a War Dog that is itself within 6" of this model must take a Battle-shock test at the start of the Fight phase.

name: Vortex Terrors (Psychic)
summary: At the start of your Shooting phase, force one enemy unit within 24" and visible to this model to take a Battle-shock test.

name: Warp Storms (Psychic)
summary: At the end of your Movement phase, roll a D6 for each enemy unit within 9" of this model: on a 3+ that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

name: Harbingers of Dread
summary: Chaos Knights units always have Deathly Terror: enemy units within 9" have Leadership worsened by 1. At the start of rounds 1, 3 and 5, add one chosen Dread ability or two rolled at random; each lasts the battle, duplicates do nothing.

name: Super-heavy Walker
summary: When this model makes a Normal, Advance, or Fall Back move, it can move through non-TITANIC models and terrain up to 4" tall (ending outside Engagement Range), or through taller terrain risking Battle-shock on a D6 roll of 1.
